race.comment: SIR BOOM A LOT (9) started hard in the market on debut and ran accordingly with a game on-pace second over 900m at this track. Only has to repeat that effort to get the job done. LOVE YOU ANYWAY (6) was three weeks between runs when she jumped in trip for a battling fourth over 1200m at Tamworth. Will go back from the gate and be ridden for luck from the awkward gate. Each way.  EXCELS (4) tongue-tie goes on for this after she went out hard and folded up in the straight with a poor sixth over this track and trip. Pulled up with a slow recovery rate last start and the senior rider hops on for this. Deserves another chance. APACHE COMMAND (3) best performance in six career starts when she gripped on in the heavy going to finish second over 900m at Newcastle. Finds an easier race and worth thought.
